name: Clio
source:
Clios calm and understanding nature makes him a dependable source of comfort and guidance.

He keeps his own emotions locked away, afraid to be vulnerable or close to others.

Growing up with cold, demanding parents, Clio became a therapist to connect with others emotionally, though he still struggles to allow himself true intimacy.
